Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer and the cost-structure explanation; the index movements alone do not justify the proposed unit price. Please send your cost breakdown in XLSX format so we can examine the index-linked elements and establish scope for a materially lower unit price. A longer contract term can form part of that discussion; meanwhile, please identify the price reductions you can approve within your own authority.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -0.3% from 2026-03 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06), well below the +4.5% you ask for. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.77, index_clause None, payment_days 45, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.82, index_clause None, payment_days 90, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.74, index_clause None, payment_days 14, contract_months 24). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

Thank you for confirming the volume for a 24-month period; however, please note that our detailed cost breakdown is proprietary and cannot be shared. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We are agreeable to extending the contract to 24 months with 45-day payment terms, provided we implement the AS-14404 index clause to manage material price volatility. 

Reflecting the verified index movements and the new contract parameters, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit, under a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Thank you for revising your offer and recognising the confirmed commitment; an index clause must be matched by a lower base price and an appropriate deadband, not simply added to the proposed terms. While we note your confidentiality concerns, please provide a suitably redacted cost breakdown in XLSX format so we can assess the individual cost elements against the cited indices and avoid overlapping adjustments. Please also identify the further price reduction available within your current approval authority while any broader adjustment is considered.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.84, index_clause None, payment_days 14, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.89, index_clause None, payment_days 60, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.86, index_clause None, payment_days 30, contract_months 24). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
